name: Off-by-One Array Index Loop
diff:
diff --git a/app/search.py b/app/search.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/app/search.py
+++ b/app/search.py
@@ -1,4 +1,7 @@
 def process_tokens(tokens):
+    n = len(tokens)
+    # Loop bounds exceed list length
+    for i in range(n + 1):
+        print(tokens[i])
explanation: Iterating up to range(n + 1) raises IndexError on the final index.
